test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A party that secures at least _______ percent of the total votes in Lok Sabha elections or Assembly Elections in four states and wins at least four seats in the Lok Sabha is recognized as a National Party.
solution:
The correct answer is __**6**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A National Party is a political party in India that operates in more than one state and is recognized by the** Election Commission of India**.
 
• At least **6% of the total votes** in any four states in the Lok Sabha elections or Assembly elections.
 
• Wins **at least four seats** in the Lok Sabha from any state or states.
 
• Alternatively, the party must have been recognized as a **State Party in at least four states**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A State Party is one that is recognized within a specific state and does not meet the criteria to be considered a **National Party**.
 
• State Parties must secure at least** 6% of the vote in the Assembly elections** or win a specific number of seats in a state legislature to achieve recognition.
 
• National Parties are allotted specific **symbols by the Election Commission**, which they use during elections to help voters identify them easily.
 
• As of now, the** recognized National Parties in India include**:
 
 
• Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)
 
• Indian National Congress (INC)
 
• All India Trinamool Congress (AITC)
 
• Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)
 
• Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK)
 
• Communist Party of India (Marxist) (CPI-M)
 
• Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP)
